verdict.rationale: The only story-relevant evidence is a community note that GitLab's GitHub importer brings over issues and milestones, which implies GitLab has native milestones that hold issues. Nothing documents assigning issues to milestones, setting milestone due dates, or tracking progress against them. Missing for 10: first-party docs on milestones, evidence of milestone due dates, documented issue-to-milestone assignment, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates

citations.quote: the GitHub importer brings over repo data, description, issues, pull requests, wiki pages, milestones, labels
